# WDC 65C816 (extension)

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/mos65816.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

53 mnemonics, 119 encoded forms, operands little-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/mos65816.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/mos65816.rs).

Cycle counts show the base cost; `+p` is an extra cycle when an
indexed access crosses a page boundary, `+t` when a branch is taken.
